source_timestamp: Sentinel-1 2024-09-15T23:16:14Z; image before: the last pass of the same orbit the source holds; dry-season passes of 24 February, 7 March and 12 April 2024
confidence_basis: Sentinel-1 backscatter read by fixed rules and one frozen detector; no reading was checked on the ground.
what_this_is: The radar readings of the Sentinel-1 pass of 15 September 2024 over Mae Sai district, frozen before any THEOS-2 image of September 2024 was received.

what_each_reading_is.frozen_detector: the detector frozen in decision log R37: VH after at or below the frozen threshold, cleaned (slope, group size, growth)
what_each_reading_is.simple_threshold: VH after at or below the frozen threshold, not cleaned
what_each_reading_is.un_spider_dry_baseline: the UN-SPIDER quotient rule with the median of three dry-season passes as its image before
what_each_reading_is.un_spider_last_pass_before: the UN-SPIDER quotient rule with the last pass of the same orbit before the event as its image before
what_each_reading_is.m1_literal_last_pass_before: rule M1-literal with the same image before
what_each_reading_is.m1_v2_last_pass_before: the frozen rule M1-v2 with the same image before

assumptions: The radar readings are those of one Sentinel-1 pass, four to five days after the peak of the flood at Mae Sai.
The water of a THEOS-2 image is read by one rule (NDWI, three-class Otsu) with no setting made by eye; it is not a check on the ground.
Cells of permanent water and cells outside the district are left out of every count.
limits: One optical image, hours after the radar pass: water that came or went in between counts against the radar.
Radar cannot see water under roofs and trees; the counts by stratum say how much of the compared ground that is.
Report-only. No published class changes and nothing enters a planning score.
